# Baristo.Online

> Baristo.Online is a premium Indian high-altitude Arabica coffee brand store — two dark master roasts (Dark, Truly Dark), twelve functional recipes, and a refined daily ritual.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Brand store landing with the roast collection, case packs, A+ brand story, quality evidence, and recipe ecosystem.
- [Our Story](/story): How Baristo sources, roasts, evidences and packs its two dark roasts.
- [Dark Roast](/roasts/dark): Deeper body with espresso-minded structure — brew guidance, tasting notes, and linked recipes.
- [Truly Dark Roast](/roasts/truly-dark): Bold, intense, roasted depth — brew guidance, tasting notes, and linked recipes.
